title: Religion as everyday resistance: Birsaite Dharam in contemporary Jharkhand

scope.topic: Birsaite Dharam, collective identity and everyday resistance
scope.method_boundary: publisher page states the article draws on fieldwork; detailed participant-derived material appears in publisher notes and must not be promoted without consent/cultural-access review
scope.munda_specificity: directly relevant to Birsa Munda/Birsaite contexts but not automatically representative of all Munda communities

evidence_decision.reason: The publisher page verifies identity, bibliographic metadata, abstract and fieldwork scope, but participant-derived statements, ritual details and other culturally sensitive content require exact-passage review plus rights/consent/cultural-access checks before structured evidence promotion.

non_inferences: No claim of community endorsement or community validation.
No claim that Birsaite practices described are universal across Munda communities.
No claim that participant quotations or field notes are reusable.
No claim that publisher access equals cultural permission.
No claim that the article resolves contemporary religious diversity among Munda communities.
